translations.오늘 품절·예약·미완료 업무를 읽고 본인 업무에 영향을 주는 항목을 하나: Read today's sold-out items, reservations and unfinished work, and identify each item affecting your work.
Check the date first so you do not mistake yesterday's notes for today's notice.
translations.담당과 도움받을 사람 확인: Confirm responsibilities and who can help
translations.빈 근무 시간과 오늘 버디를 확인하고 모르는 업무를 누구에게 물을지 정해: Check uncovered shift times and today's buddy, and decide whom to ask about unfamiliar work.
Agree on responsibilities before starting equipment work you cannot do alone.
translations.내 구역을 한 바퀴 돌고 부족한 준비를 담당자에게 직접 알려요. 인수인계: Walk around your area and tell the responsible person directly about missing preparations. Confirm the handover is complete.
Reading the notes is different from finishing the preparations.
translations.전처리 도구와 작업대 준비: Prepare food-prep tools and work surfaces
translations.원물과 완성식품 구역 나누기: Separate raw ingredients and ready-to-eat food areas
Prepare raw and ready-to-eat ingredients with separate containers and tools, and check labels.
Check each tool's purpose rather than relying only on its color.
translations.작업대 세척 후 준비: Clean the work surface before preparing
translations.찌꺼기와 오염을 먼저 제거하고 매장 제품 지침대로 세척·소독해요. 필요한: Remove debris and contamination first, then clean and sanitize according to the store product instructions. Check the required contact time and rinsing.
Do not finish by merely spraying sanitizer onto a dusty surface.
translations.오늘 사용할 양만 소분: Portion only the amount needed today
translations.예상 주문과 레시피에 맞춰 소분하고 재료명·준비 시각·사용 기준을 표시해: Portion according to expected orders and recipes; label the ingredient name, preparation time and use criteria.
Check remaining stock before deciding additional prep quantities to avoid duplicate preparation.
translations.설거지 구역 정리 확인: Check the dishwashing area is organized
Empty food scraps and arrange dishes so dirty and clean dish routes do not cross.
Do not return clean dishes to a dirty basket.
translations.매장 세척기·세제 지침대로 처리한 뒤 음식물과 세제 잔여를 확인하고 지정: Follow the store dishwasher and detergent instructions, check for food and detergent residue, then place dishes on the designated drying rack.
Check that moisture is not trapped between stacked dishes.
translations.배수망과 바닥 정리: Clear drain strainers and tidy the floor
translations.배수망 찌꺼기를 수거하고 도구를 제자리에 둬요. 물기를 정리한 뒤 통로를: Collect debris from drain strainers and return tools to their places. Clear moisture before opening the passage.
Do not finish by placing only a warning sign on a wet floor.
translations.손 씻기와 위생복·위생모 착용: Wash hands and put on hygienic clothing and a hair covering
translations.탈의 후 비누로 30초 이상 손을 씻고 매장 위생복·위생모(주방은 마스크: After changing, wash hands with soap for at least 30 seconds and wear the store's hygienic clothing and hair covering (a mask in the kitchen). Cover hand wounds with waterproof dressings and gloves, and tell the supervisor.
translations.앞치마를 화장실까지 입고 가지 않아요. 휴대폰을 만졌으면 다시 손을 씻어: Do not wear your apron into the toilet. Wash hands again after touching your phone.
translations.설사·구토·발열·인후통이 있으면 조리·배식 전에 사장님이나 매니저에게 먼: Tell the owner or manager before cooking or serving if you have diarrhea, vomiting, fever or a sore throat. The owner maintains records of health examinations 1 time a year (typhoid, paratyphoid and pulmonary tuberculosis).
Store rules require reporting illness, rather than working through it.
translations.마감 메모에서 품절 재료, 남은 육수·초벌 등뼈 양, 예약, 고장 난 장: Check closing notes for sold-out ingredients, remaining broth and parboiled pork spine quantities, reservations and broken equipment; identify what affects your work.
Check the date first. It is easy to mistake yesterday's notes for today's situation.
translations.오픈·피크·마감 담당과 오늘 버디를 확인해요. 혼자 하기 어려운 육수 솥: Check who handles opening, peak hours and closing, and today's buddy. Assign responsibility before starting broth-pot or burner work that is difficult to do alone.
Asking before unfamiliar work is the quickest way to proceed.
translations.오픈 · 홀과 셀프바 준비: Opening: prepare dining area and self-service station
translations.간판·조명·냉난방 켜고 안내문 확인: Switch on signage, lighting and climate control; check notices
translations.간판과 홀 조명, 냉난방을 켜요. 출입문의 영업시간(11:30~22:00: Switch on signage, dining-area lights and heating or air conditioning. Check that entrance notices clearly show business hours (11:30~22:00), break time (14:00~16:00, excluding weekends) and last orders at 21:30.
Missing notices mean twice as much explaining to customers.
translations.테이블마다 휴지·물티슈·앞접시 받침·뼈 버리는 통을 놓고 의자를 정렬해요: Put tissues, wet wipes, side-plate stands and bone-disposal containers on each table; align chairs. Check a trivet is present where a hot pot will be placed.
Sticky table surfaces are easier to see under bright opening-time lighting than during closing.
translations.앞접시·국그릇·수저·집게를 채우고 밑반찬(매장 구성)을 반찬통에 담아 뚜: Stock side plates, soup bowls, cutlery and tongs. Put the store's side dishes into containers and cover them. Provide separate tongs for each dish and label the filling time.
Refill customer-served side dishes frequently in small amounts to reduce waste.
translations.소금·후추·양념통과 물 준비: Prepare salt, pepper, condiments and water
translations.셀프바 옆 소금·후추·다대기 통을 채우고 정수기·물병·컵을 확인해요. 뼈: Fill salt, pepper and spicy seasoning containers beside the self-service station; check the water dispenser, bottles and cups. Customers often use these seasonings with pork-bone soup.
Wash and dry salt shakers with blocked lid holes before refilling.
translations.매장 주차 공간의 장애물과 입구 바닥·유리를 정리해요. 우천 시 우산 꽂: Remove obstacles from the store's parking spaces and clean the entrance floor and glass. In rain, put out an umbrella stand and slip warning signs.
Tidy the entrance in the last 5 minutes before the first customers arrive.
translations.라벨의 부위·중량·입고일을 확인하고 색과 냄새가 정상인지 봐요. 이상하면: Check the cut, weight and arrival date on the label, and ensure color and smell are normal. If abnormal, do not use it; notify the owner with a photo.
Recording thawing start time for frozen pork spine helps calculate blood-soaking time.
translations.찬물(매장 레시피의 설탕물 여부)에 등뼈를 담가 매장 기준 시간 동안 핏: Soak pork spine in cold water (check whether the store recipe uses sugar water) for the store-specified time, changing the water during soaking. Mark the start time on the container.
translations.핏물이 덜 빠지면 육수가 탁하고 잡내가 나요. 시간을 눈대중으로 줄이지: Insufficient blood removal makes broth cloudy and unpleasant-smelling. Do not shorten the time by guesswork.
translations.끓는 물에 매장 향신채(월계수잎·통후추·생강·소주 등 레시피 기준)를 넣: Add the store recipe's aromatics (bay leaves, whole peppercorns, ginger, soju, etc.) to boiling water; parboil pork spine for the specified time and discard the water.
Never use the parboiling water as broth.
translations.흐르는 찬물에 뼈를 하나씩 헹궈 핏덩이·뼈가루·불순물을 제거해요. 씻은: Rinse each bone under running cold water to remove blood clots, bone dust and impurities. Put washed bones into a clean dedicated tray.
Do not mix tools used for raw bones with trays holding washed bones.
translations.소·중·대 기준 무게(매장 레시피)로 나눠 용기에 담고 재료명·소분 시각: Divide into small, medium and large portions by the store recipe's weights; label ingredient name, portioning time and use criteria, then refrigerate.
Use evening reservations and yesterday's sales to plan portions and reduce leftover bones.
translations.준비 · 육수와 기본 뼈곰탕 국물: Preparation: broth and basic pork-bone soup
translations.솥의 물량과 초벌 등뼈·대파·마늘·생강 등 매장 레시피 재료를 확인하고: Check the water quantity, parboiled pork spine and recipe ingredients such as spring onion, garlic and ginger, then turn on the heat. Record the start time.
After opening the gas valve, stay until you confirm ignition.
translations.거품·기름 걷기와 불 조절: Skim foam and fat; adjust heat
translations.끓기 시작하면 거품과 기름을 걷고 매장 기준 화력으로 낮춰요. 물이 줄면: When boiling begins, skim foam and fat and lower heat to the store standard. If water decreases, top up only with hot water.
Cold water makes the soup cloudy and lengthens cooking time.
translations.오늘 주문에 제공할 식전 국물 종류와 품절 대체 기준을 담당자에게 확인해: Ask the responsible person which starter soup is served with today's orders and how to substitute sold-out items. Reviews mention pork-bone broth, bean-sprout soup and no starter soup; do not label it as included with every order.
Do not mix yesterday's soup left at the bottom of the warmer into fresh soup.
translations.어제 보관한 육수가 있으면 사장님·매니저에게 사용 여부를 확인받고, 승인: If stored broth from yesterday remains, ask the owner or manager whether it may be used; reheat and use only approved broth.
Do not decide to use it just because it smells acceptable.
translations.준비 · 양념·사리·사이드: Preparation: seasonings, add-ons and side dishes
translations.뼈찜 양념장 소분: Portion sauce for braised pork spine
translations.산뼈찜과 화산뼈찜의 오늘 판매 옵션·매운 단계와 매장 승인 양념 준비 기: Check today's San and Hwasan braised-pork-spine options, spice levels and approved sauce-preparation standards; label each container. Enter proportions and quantities only after the store recipe is finalized.
Distinguish similarly colored sauces by labels, not their locations.
translations.오늘 메뉴별 소스 제공 기준을 담당자에게 확인하고 종류별 준비분을 식별해: Ask the responsible person about today's sauce service for each menu item and identify each prepared batch. Reviews describe different sauces such as soy-mustard sauce for San and mayonnaise sauce for Hwasan braised pork spine; do not fix these as universal.
translations.소스 종류와 제공 여부를 주문별로 확인해요. 화산뼈찜에 마요소스가 제공된: Check sauce type and whether it is served for each order. Some reviews also describe mayonnaise sauce with Hwasan braised pork spine.
translations.사리·볶음밥 재료 확인: Check noodle add-ons and fried-rice ingredients
translations.오늘 판매하는 우동·칼국수사리와 계란볶음밥·식후 볶음밥을 구분해 준비분을: Check today's udon and kalguksu noodle add-ons, egg fried rice and after-meal fried rice separately. Confirm separate or combined noodle service and its timing against the order ticket and store standards.
translations.피크에 사리가 떨어지면 주문을 못 받아요. 준비 시간에 세는 것이 가장: Running out of noodle add-ons at peak time prevents taking orders. Counting during preparation is easiest.
translations.감자·우거지·채소 손질: Prepare potatoes, cabbage greens and vegetables
translations.감자·우거지(시래기)·콩나물·대파를 매장 레시피 크기로 손질해 용기에 담: Cut potatoes, cabbage greens (dried radish greens), bean sprouts and spring onions to the store recipe's sizes; put them into containers and label preparation times.
Use separate cutting boards for raw bones and vegetables.
translations.뼈찜 위에 꽂는 깃발 등 데코 소품과 집게·가위·앞접시 예비분을 배식대에: Stock serving counters with decorations such as flags placed on braised pork spine, plus spare tongs, scissors and side plates.
Replace wet or torn decorations immediately.
translations.주문번호·테이블과 메뉴(산뼈찜·화산뼈찜·뼈곰탕·뼈짬뽕), 수량·사이즈·맵: Check the order number, table and menu (San or Hwasan braised pork spine, pork-bone soup or pork-bone spicy noodle soup), quantity, size, spice level, noodle/rice choice, add-ons, fried-rice type and exclusions.
Standardize order-ticket notation so portion size is not confused with party size.
translations.주문 메뉴와 사이즈·맵기·제외 요청을 준비분에 대조하고 매장 책임자가 승: Match the ordered menu, size, spice level and exclusions to prepared portions; confirm the cooking procedure and completion criteria approved by the store supervisor. Do not determine times, heat or ingredients from reviews alone.
Check cooking time, heat and doneness against the manual approved by the store supervisor.
translations.완성 확인과 마무리: Check the finished dish and final details
translations.본품과 주문표를 대조한 뒤 오늘 매장 기준에 맞는 동반 소스·국물·사리의: Match the main dish to the order ticket; confirm today's sauce, soup and noodle types and whether served separately or together. Reviews describe different service styles, so do not assume a single fixed method.
translations.우동사리가 별도로 나온 후기와 본품에 함께 나온 후기가 있어요. 오늘 기: Some reviews describe udon served separately and others together with the main dish. Check today's standard.
translations.계란볶음밥 추가 주문과 식후 볶음밥 요청을 별개 항목으로 확인해요. 실제: Treat additional egg fried rice orders and after-meal fried rice requests as separate items. Follow store standards for actual product relationships and cooking/service timing; coordinate order changes with the dining-area team.
After receiving an actual after-meal request, match the order number and table.
translations.완성된 냄비는 받침 위에 올려 배식대에 두고 홀에 콜해요. 냄비 손잡이와: Place the finished pot on a trivet at the serving counter and call the dining-area team. Check pot handles and broth overflow.
Pots left at the serving counter too long lose both temperature and appearance.
translations.주문에서 메뉴·사이즈·맵기·사리·면/밥 선택·볶음밥·제외 요청을 확인해요: Confirm menu, size, spice level, noodle add-ons, noodle/rice choice, fried rice and exclusions. Check today's store standard before explaining sauces and starter soup.
Do not assume options mentioned in reviews are today's available menu.
translations.기본 국물과 셀프바 안내: Explain starter soup and self-service station
translations.오늘 매장 기준에 따라 식전 국물 제공 여부와 셀프바 이용 방법을 안내해: Explain whether starter soup is served and how to use the self-service station according to today's store standards. Reviews differ on soup type, sold-out substitutions and no-soup service; do not claim it is always included.
If soup is sold out, confirm approved substitutes and explanation wording.
translations.뼈찜 세팅: Set up braised pork spine service
translations.뜨거운 본품과 주문표의 사리·소스·추가품을 대조해요. 사리의 제공 시점과: Match the hot main dish with noodle add-ons, sauces and extras on the order ticket. Check store standards and customer requests for noodle timing and separate or combined service.
Move water cups off the table before putting down the pot.
translations.중간 수거와 반찬 보충: Clear dishes during the meal and refill side dishes
Collect bone containers and empty dishes during meals; refill self-service side dishes before they run out. Mark the refill time.
Replace containers rather than pouring fresh side dishes onto leftovers.
translations.결제와 라스트오더 안내: Take payment and explain last orders
translations.결제 시 주문 내역을 확인하고 21:00 이후 입장 손님에게는 라스트오더: Check order details at payment; tell customers arriving after 21:00 that last orders are at 21:30.
Tell customers arriving just before the break when service ends as you seat them.
translations.피크 · 포장·배달 주문: Peak hours: takeaway and delivery orders
translations.지정된 포장 구역에서 손을 30초 이상 씻고 위생장갑·위생모·마스크를 착: In the designated packing area, wash hands for at least 30 seconds and wear hygienic gloves, a hair covering and a mask. Replace gloves after other work.
Ask delivery drivers not to enter the kitchen or packing area.
translations.식품용 표시가 있는 깨끗한 용기에 집게·국자로 담아요. 뼈찜 본체, 사리: Use tongs or ladles to fill clean containers labeled for food use. Pack braised pork spine, noodle add-ons, special sauce, side dishes and fried rice separately; keep hot and cold food from touching.
Fill broth-heavy braised pork spine only to the store's specified container fill line.
translations.밀폐와 주문 대조: Seal and check against the order
translations.뚜껑을 닫고 기울여 국물이 새지 않는지 확인한 뒤 주문표와 메뉴·사이즈·: Close the lid and tilt to check for broth leaks; then match menu, size, noodles, sauces and cutlery count to the order ticket.
Checking before closing the bag avoids reopening it.
translations.포장을 마치면 바로 출고 선반에 두고 주문 번호를 표시해요. 외부에 오래: As soon as packing is finished, put the order on the dispatch shelf and label its number. Do not leave it outside for long.
Tell the dining-area team immediately if the delivery app's estimated time is delayed.
translations.브레이크타임 · 정리와 저녁 준비: Break time: cleanup and dinner preparation
translations.14:00에 출입문 안내를 브레이크(16:00 재오픈)로 바꾸고 식사 중: At 14:00, change the entrance notice to break time (reopening at 16:00); let customers already eating finish comfortably. There is no break on weekends.
Include reopening time when answering phone enquiries.
translations.홀·셀프바 정리: Tidy the dining area and self-service station
translations.테이블과 바닥을 정리하고 셀프바 반찬은 뚜껑을 덮어 냉장 보관하거나 매장: Tidy tables and floors; cover and refrigerate self-service side dishes or handle them according to store disposal criteria. Replace side-dish containers and tongs.
Do not reuse side dishes for dinner that sat out for a long time at lunch.
translations.육수·초벌 등뼈 점검: Check broth and parboiled pork spine
translations.육수 잔량과 상태를 보고 저녁용을 보충해요. 저녁 예약과 점심 판매량으로: Check remaining broth and its condition, then top up for dinner. Use evening reservations and lunch sales to plan parboiled pork spine portions.
Note sizes that ran short during the lunch rush to speed up dinner preparation.
translations.우동사리·계란·밥·포장 용기·앞접시 예비분을 세고 부족한 것은 앱의 보충: Count udon add-ons, eggs, rice, packing containers and spare side plates; record shortages as replenishment requests in the app.
Decide dinner orders during the break so they are not late.
translations.직원 식사와 휴식을 교대로 하고 16:00 재오픈 5분 전 각자 자리로: Take staff meals and breaks in rotation; return to your stations 5 minutes before reopening at 16:00.
Rest time is part of the shift too. Do not call someone unless it is urgent.
translations.육수와 초벌 등뼈 처리: Handle broth and parboiled pork spine
translations.남은 육수·초벌 등뼈·양념장은 사장님·매니저 기준에 따라 보관 또는 폐기: Store or discard remaining broth, parboiled pork spine and sauces according to owner/manager standards. Divide stored portions into small containers and mark the date and time.
Leaving food in a large pot makes its center cool slowly.
translations.감자·우거지·사리·볶음밥 재료를 뚜껑 덮어 냉장 보관하고 소비 기준을 표: Cover and refrigerate potatoes, cabbage greens, noodles and fried-rice ingredients; label use criteria. Keep raw bones and prepared vegetables in separate compartments.
Keep them in consistent locations so tomorrow's prep person can find them.
translations.화구·후드·솥 세척과 가스 차단: Clean burners, hood and pot; shut off gas
translations.화구와 후드 필터, 육수 솥을 매장 세제 지침대로 세척하고 가스 밸브를: Clean burners, hood filters and broth pots according to store detergent instructions; close the gas valve.
The last person checks the gas valve one more time.
translations.식기 세척과 배수망 정리: Wash dishes and clear drain strainers
translations.냄비·앞접시·뼈 통을 세척해 건조대에 놓고 배수망 찌꺼기를 비워요. 바닥: Wash pots, side plates and bone containers; place them on the drying rack. Empty drain-strainer debris and remove water from the floor.
Bone containers retain odors easily; rinse them once more with hot water.
translations.냉장고 정리와 인수인계 메모: Organize the refrigerator and write handover notes

translations.변경사항을 담당자와 고객에게 전달하고 합의한 내용을 필요한 범위로 기록해: Tell the responsible person and customer about changes; record agreements only as needed.
Check services completed and requests remaining; hand over to the follow-up person.
translations.보관 장소별 수량과 사용 가능한 상태를 확인한 뒤 필요한 구매량을 정해요: Check quantities and usability by storage location before deciding purchases needed.
translations.품목·수량·납기와 실제 입고를 대조하고 파손이나 누락은 분리해 담당자에게: Compare items, quantities and delivery dates to actual receipts; separate damage or shortages and report them.
Record arrival locations and handling results so the next person can find them.
translations.청소할 구역과 출입 제한이 필요한 곳을 확인해요. 제품 표시와 현장 지침: Identify areas to clean and places needing restricted access. Prepare tools matching product labels and site instructions.
translations.사용자 동선을 확보하고 구역별 승인된 순서로 청소해요. 서로 다른 약품을: Keep user routes safe; clean in each area's approved order. Do not arbitrarily mix different chemicals.
Check wet floors and remaining items; hand over unfinished work or facility issues.
translations.시설 이상 발견·조치 인계: Identify facility issues and hand over action
translations.출입 동선과 사용 설비의 눈에 보이는 이상을 확인해요. 장비를 임의로 분: Check visible abnormalities in access routes and equipment used. Do not disassemble equipment without permission.
translations.이상 사용 중지·보고: Stop unsafe use and report issues
translations.위험한 상태는 접근과 사용을 멈추고 현장 책임자에게 위치와 상태를 알려요: Stop access and use in dangerous conditions; tell the site supervisor the location and condition.
Record the person responsible for action and unresolved matters; hand over to the next shift.
translations.근무·담당·신규 크루 인계: Hand over shifts, responsibilities and new crew
Check today's staffing, vacancies and responsibility for each task.
translations.새 크루의 버디와 교육 범위를 확인하고 혼자 하면 안 되는 작업을 안내해: Check the new crew member's buddy and training scope; explain work they must not do alone.
Distinguish complete, incomplete and abnormal items; confirm with the next person.
translations.진행 중 고객 요청·물품·작업을 확인하고 보관 위치와 다음 담당을 정해요: Check ongoing customer requests, goods and work; assign storage locations and the next person.
translations.담당 권한 안에서 결제·취소·환불 기록을 대조하고 차이는 승인 없이 임의: Within your authority, compare payment, cancellation and refund records; do not arbitrarily adjust discrepancies without approval.
translations.시설 종료·다음 날 인계: Shut facilities and hand over for the next day
translations.현장 종료 지침에 따라 설비와 잠금 상태를 확인하고 다음 날 필요한 일을: Follow site closing instructions to check equipment and locks; hand over work needed tomorrow.
translations.요청·납기·결과물 인계: Hand over requests, deadlines and deliverables
Confirm requested deliverables, due dates and the inspection person.
Record change requests and agreements; tell the relevant responsible people.
Match final-deliverable versions and recipients; check access permissions.
translations.생산 작업 전후 인계: Handover before and after production work
Check work items, approved instructions, responsible people and required training.
translations.자재와 도구의 식별을 대조하고 손상·이상품은 정상품과 구분해 책임자에게: Match material and tool identifiers; separate damaged or abnormal items from good ones and tell the supervisor.
translations.결과·미완료 인계: Hand over results and unfinished work
Hand over completed quantities, unfinished work and issues using the site's recording method.
Check the approved scope, site supervisor and whether access or work permits are needed.
If site conditions differ from the work plan, do not start; check with the supervisor.
translations.종료·미해결 인계: Hand over closure and unresolved matters
Hand over work-area condition, remaining action and the next person responsible.
translations.작업·출하 기록 인계: Hand over work and dispatch records
translations.오늘 작업·출하 일정과 담당을 확인해요. 장비·약품은 승인된 지침과 교육: Check today's work/dispatch schedule and responsibilities. Use equipment and chemicals only within approved instructions and training.
Compare dispatched items, quantities, labels and destinations; separate and report abnormal goods.
translations.미완료·보관 인계: Hand over unfinished work and storage
Tell the next person where remaining goods are and what work is unfinished.
translations.접수·비진료 행정 인계: Hand over reception and non-clinical administration
Check appointment schedules and administrative responsibilities in the approved system.
Ensure sensitive information is not exposed on public screens or shared records.
translations.요청을 담당자에게 인계: Refer requests to the responsible person
Refer requests requiring clinical, medication or treatment decisions to the relevant professionals.
translations.CCTV 설치·안내·접근 기준 확인: Check CCTV installation, notices and access standards
Consult official guidance on whether the purpose and location are permitted.
translations.설치 목적·장소, 촬영 범위·시간, 관리책임자 연락처 등 필요한 내용을: Compare required information such as purpose/location, recording scope/time and responsible manager contact details with the notice board.
translations.접근 권한과 보관·처리 기준을 정하고 목적 외 이용이나 제공 요청은 담당: Set access, retention and processing standards; ask the responsible person about off-purpose use or disclosure requests.
translations.영업 인허가·등록 대상 확인: Check business licensing and registration applicability
translations.실제 영업과 대상 대조: Match actual business to applicable categories
translations.제공할 서비스와 품목을 정리하고 관계 법령상 허가·등록·신고 대상인지 확: List services and items to be provided; check whether relevant laws require permission, registration or notification.
translations.대상 업종의 관할 기관과 개시 전 절차를 확인하고 필요한 증빙과 변경 사: Identify the responsible authority and pre-opening procedures for the business type; organize required evidence and changes.
translations.우리매장 영업시간에 설정된 오늘의 브레이크 시작·종료 시각을 확인해 안내: Check today's break start/end times configured in Our store business hours and update notices. Do not arbitrarily apply specific times or exclude weekends.
translations.진행 중인 응대와 전달할 사항을 담당 파트에 남겨요. 영업 브레이크와 크: Leave ongoing service and handover matters with the responsible part. Business breaks and individual crew rest are separate; do not assign work during personal breaks.
At the configured reopening time, check notices and readiness of the responsible parts.
Tidy work surfaces and used tools; process according to store cleaning and sanitizing methods.
translations.남은 식품은 제품·공정별 보관 기준으로 처리해요. 시간·상태가 불명확한: Handle leftover food according to product/process storage standards. Do not serve food with unclear time or condition; tell the supervisor.
translations.다음 영업에 부족한 재료와 도구만 기존 재고·보충 요청에 남겨요. 같은: Record only ingredients and tools short for the next service in existing stock/replenishment requests. Do not record the same quantity again.
translations.등뼈·육수 다음 영업 준비: Prepare pork spine and broth for the next service
translations.예정 판매량과 남은 준비분을 확인해 초벌 등뼈·육수의 필요한 수량을 정해: Check expected sales and remaining prepared portions; determine needed quantities of parboiled pork spine and broth.
Check approved pork-spine prep, broth recipes and storage standards. Do not substitute reheating for an unclear cooked-food storage history.
translations.배치와 냉각 시작 확인: Identify the batch and cooling start
translations.육수인지 해산물 등이 들어간 완성 국물인지 구분해요. 실제 제조량·용기·: Distinguish stock from finished soup containing seafood or other ingredients. Record actual production quantity, containers, cooling equipment and start time. Do not leave a large pot at room temperature to cool slowly.
translations.매장에 검증된 용기 분할·냉각 방법을 사용하고 정해진 시점의 실제 시간·: Use store-validated container division and cooling methods; record actual times and temperatures at specified points. If outside standards, do not mark normal completion; hold use and notify the supervisor.
Label batch name, production/cooling times, storage location and use deadline confirmed by the store. Check history at next use. Do not arbitrarily apply one fixed storage duration to all spicy noodle soup.
translations.제품 표시의 보관방법과 소비기한을 확인해요. 실온 유통 밀봉 제품, 냉장: Check labeled storage instructions and use-by date. Distinguish sealed products distributed at room temperature, chilled/frozen products, and opened, thawed, soaked or cooked states.
translations.제품과 로트, 실제 개봉 시각, 매장에 확인된 개봉 후 보관조건·기한과: Record product and lot, actual opening time, store-confirmed after-opening conditions/deadline and location. Do not apply the sealed-product use-by date unchanged after opening.
translations.표시와 실제 보관 이력을 대조해요. 불린 떡에 일반 제품의 기간을 적용하: Compare labels to actual storage history. Do not apply ordinary-product durations to soaked rice cakes. Hold use and notify the supervisor if mold, other abnormalities or unclear history are found.
translations.개인 물품을 지정 장소에 두고 매장에서 정한 복장과 개인 위생 기준을 확: Put personal items in designated places; check store dress and personal-hygiene standards. Tell the supervisor before starting about health conditions or difficulties affecting work.
If standards are missing or hard to follow, ask the responsible person and record the situation.
translations.품절·예약·고장·미완료 업무를 이전 담당과 확인해요. 맡을 업무와 도움이: Confirm sold-out items, reservations, faults and unfinished work with the previous person. Decide what you will handle and what needs help; leave information for the next person.
translations.통행을 방해하는 물건을 정리하고 우리매장에 설정된 영업시간·브레이크 안내: Clear items obstructing passage; check that onsite notices match business hours and breaks set in Our store.
translations.테이블·의자의 상태와 청결을 확인하고 매장 제공 방식에 맞는 식기·비품을: Check table/chair condition and cleanliness; prepare dishes and supplies suited to the service method. Refill missing items from linked storage locations.
translations.셀프바를 운영하는 경우 취급 품목별 매장 기준에 맞춰 준비해요. 전용 도: If operating a self-service station, prepare each item according to store standards. Check dedicated tools, labels and storage; ask the supervisor about items with unknown standards.
translations.작업대·손 씻는 곳·도구의 준비 상태를 확인해요. 용도별 구분과 설비 사: Check readiness of work surfaces, handwashing places and tools. Follow store/manufacturer instructions for separation by purpose and equipment pre-use checks.
translations.오늘 메뉴와 준비량·품절 사항을 확인해요. 사용할 재료의 표시와 보관 상: Check today's menu, prep quantities and sold-out items. Check ingredient labels and storage; report abnormalities before use.
translations.재고와 사용 예정량, 입고 대기 주문을 함께 확인해요. 같은 품목을 중복: Check stock, planned use and orders awaiting arrival together. Compare units and quantities to avoid duplicate orders.
translations.공급처·규격·수량·납품 예정일을 확인하고 승인 권한에 맞춰 발주 요청을: Confirm supplier, specification, quantity and expected arrival date; pass requests according to approval authority. Distinguish demo orders in the app from actual supplier transmission.
translations.실제 도착한 품목의 이름·규격·수량을 주문과 비교해요. 누락·오배송·파손: Compare actual arrivals' names, specifications and quantities to orders. Separately record shortages, wrong deliveries and damage; notify the responsible person.
translations.품목별 검수 기준에 따라 표시·보관 상태를 확인해요. 기준에 맞지 않거나: Check labels and storage condition against each item's inspection criteria. Do not use items that fail or are hard to assess; ask the responsible person before handling them. Store only checked items in designated places and record receipt.
translations.품목별 지정 위치와 표시를 확인해요. 새 입고분과 기존 물품을 구분하고: Check each item's designated location and labels. Distinguish new arrivals from existing items and organize by store use order.
translations.대상 품목의 단위를 확인한 뒤 실물을 세어 기록해요. 수량 차이·표시 누: Check item units, count actual goods and record them. Tell the responsible person about discrepancies, missing labels or abnormal conditions. Follow inventory settings for checks after ordering.
translations.선택한 메뉴·재료의 매장 레시피와 준비량을 확인해요. 도구·작업 공간·사: Check store recipes and preparation quantities for selected menus/ingredients. Identify tools, workspace and supplies; if process standards are missing, ask the supervisor first.
translations.재료별 승인된 손질·해동·세척·소분 방법을 따라요. 사용한 재료와 준비: Follow approved preparation, thawing, washing and portioning methods for each ingredient. Label ingredients used and preparation status separately; move to specified storage.
translations.준비량·남은 작업·이상 사항을 다음 담당에게 전달해요. 실제 준비량은 준: Tell the next person prepared quantities, remaining work and issues. Compare actual prepared quantities with prepared-item records.
translations.메뉴·수량·옵션·제외 요청을 주문표와 대조해요. 알레르기 관련 요청은 추: Compare menu, quantity, options and exclusions to the order ticket. Handle allergy requests using confirmed ingredient information and supervisor instructions, not guesses.
translations.매장에서 확인한 레시피와 장비 지침에 따라 조리해요. 가열·냉각·재가열·: Cook according to store-confirmed recipes and equipment instructions. Use relevant validated standards and actual records for heating, cooling, reheating and holding hot.
translations.완성된 메뉴·수량·옵션·제공 상태를 확인하고 담당자에게 인계해요. 기준에: Check finished menu, quantities, options and serving condition; hand over to the responsible person. Address results that fail standards before serving.
Check seat, menu, quantity, options and customer requests; communicate accurately to the responsible person. Check ingredient/allergy questions you cannot answer before explaining.
translations.주문과 준비된 음식을 대조해 안내해요. 추가 요청·지연·불만은 담당자에게: Compare orders with prepared food and explain. Refer additional requests, delays and complaints to the responsible person and confirm handling.
translations.다음 손님 자리 준비: Prepare seats for the next customers
translations.사용 식기를 회수하고 매장 방법에 따라 테이블과 주변을 정리해요. 분실물: Collect used dishes and tidy tables/surroundings using store methods. Hand lost property to the designated person and replenish supplies.
translations.본품·옵션·소스·동반품을 주문표와 대조해요. 고객 요청과 제외 품목을 확: Match main items, options, sauces and accompanying items to the order ticket. Check customer requests and excluded items.
translations.메뉴에 적합한 용기와 매장 포장 방법을 사용해요. 뚜껑·누수·혼입 여부를: Use suitable containers and store packing methods. Check lids, leaks and unwanted mixing; attach required labels.
Compare order identifiers and give to the customer or driver at the designated location. Immediately refer omissions or wrong delivery to the supervisor.
translations.오늘 대상 구역·기구와 승인된 세척 방법을 확인해요. 용도별 청소도구를: Check today's areas/equipment and approved washing methods. Separate cleaning tools by purpose and check product instructions.
translations.대상에 맞는 매장 방법과 장비 지침에 따라 작업해요. 주변 식재료와 작업: Use store methods and equipment instructions suitable for the target. Keep work separate to avoid affecting nearby ingredients and tasks; return tools to designated places afterward.
translations.대상 구역과 기구가 다음 작업에 사용할 수 있는 상태인지 확인해요. 손상: Check that the area and equipment are ready for next use. Record damage, drainage problems and other abnormalities; tell the responsible person.
translations.바닥·세면대·변기·통행 상태를 확인하고 필요한 비품을 보충해요. 고장이나: Check floors, sinks, toilets and access; replenish supplies. Report faults or standing water.
translations.주방용과 구분한 도구 및 매장에서 승인한 제품 지침으로 청소해요. 사용: Clean with tools separate from kitchen tools and store-approved product instructions. Check in-use notices and completion; store tools in designated places.
translations.매장과 지역의 품목 구분에 따라 폐기물을 나눠요. 분류를 모르면 책임자에: Sort waste according to store and local item categories. Ask the supervisor if you do not know the classification.
translations.지정 장소로 배출: Take waste to the designated place
translations.연결된 배출 장소와 매장 배출 시점을 확인한 뒤 이동해요. 용기 주변 오: Check linked disposal locations and store disposal times before moving waste. Clean contamination/leaks around containers and clear passages.
translations.폐기물 보관 구역의 파손이나 해충 흔적은 담당자에게 알려요. 매장에서 승: Tell the responsible person about damage or pest signs in waste storage. Do not use unapproved chemicals or perform pest-control work without authorization.
translations.테이블·의자·바닥을 매장 청소 방법에 따라 정리해요. 손님 물품과 남은: Clean tables, chairs and floors using store methods. Check for customer belongings and remaining requests.
translations.취급 품목별 매장 보관·폐기 기준을 확인해 처리해요. 용기·도구는 지정: Check each handled item's store storage/disposal criteria and act accordingly. Wash/tidy containers and tools using specified methods; check readiness for next service.
translations.사용 중인 테이블 화구의 제조사·매장 종료 지침을 확인해요. 이상이나 종: Check manufacturer/store shutdown instructions for tabletop burners in use. Report abnormalities or uncertain shutdown status.
Sort and dispose according to store rules; use linked disposal locations.
Check dishes/supplies needed for next service and replenish from linked storage.
translations.시설 종료·인계: Shut down facilities and hand over
translations.종료할 설비와 계속 가동할 설비를 구분해 매장 지침에 따라 확인해요. 출: Distinguish equipment to shut down from equipment to keep running; check according to store instructions. Hand entrances and unfinished matters to the final responsible person.
translations.제품·공정별 확인된 매장 보관·폐기 기준에 따라 잔량을 처리하고 표시해요: Handle and label leftovers according to confirmed store storage/disposal standards for each product/process. Do not decide food with unclear standards is suitable for next service.
translations.작업대·식기·설비 정리: Tidy work surfaces, dishes and equipment
translations.오늘 세척 대상과 방법을 확인해 작업하고, 다음 사용에 필요한 상태를 확: Check today's washing targets and methods, do the work and confirm readiness for next use. Follow a separate plan for regular maintenance.
translations.계속 가동해야 하는 장비와 종료할 장비를 구별해 확인해요. 표시·보관 상: Distinguish equipment to keep running from equipment to shut down. Tell the next person about labels, storage conditions, faults and sold-out items.
translations.장비 목록과 제조사·매장 관리 계획에서 이번 대상·담당·작업 범위를 확인: Use the equipment list and manufacturer/store care plan to confirm current targets, responsibility and scope. Distinguish external contractor work from crew tasks.
translations.점검·정비 결과 인계: Hand over inspection and maintenance results
translations.허용된 작업만 수행하고 이상·조치·다음 점검 정보를 남겨요. 고장 장비의: Do only permitted work; record issues, action and next inspection information. Ask the supervisor whether faulty equipment may be used.
translations.이상·회수·영업 중단 대응: Respond to issues, recalls and service interruption
translations.고장·정전·이물·제품 회수 등 상황을 발견하면 대상과 발생 위치를 확인해: For faults, power outages, foreign matter or product recalls, identify the target and location and tell the supervisor. Follow onsite emergency instructions in urgent situations.
translations.책임자 지시에 따라 영향을 받은 물품·장비·주문을 구분하고 확인된 사실과: Under supervisor instructions, identify affected goods, equipment and orders; record confirmed facts and action. Do not reuse or restart on your own.
translations.조치 완료 여부와 남은 일을 다음 담당에게 전달해요. 영업·사용 재개는: Tell the next person what actions are complete and what remains. Resume business or use only following confirmation by the designated supervisor.
translations.담당 권한 안에서 결제·취소·환불 기록과 마감 자료를 대조해요. 차이가: Within your authority, compare payment, cancellation and refund records with closing documents. Report differences with evidence to the supervisor.
translations.미완료 주문·수리 요청·다음 영업 준비 사항을 담당과 함께 남겨요. 실제: Leave unfinished orders, repair requests and next-service preparation with responsible people. Distinguish these checks from actual payments or payroll processing.
translations.처음 하는 일은 동료와 함께 확인해 주세요. 모르는 점이나 위험한 상황은: Check unfamiliar work together with a colleague. It is okay to ask immediately about anything you do not understand or any dangerous situation.
